title: String Transforms Into Another String
summary: Given two strings of equal length, str1 and str2, assess if str1 can be converted into str2 through zero or more transformations.
statement: Given two strings of equal length, str1 and str2, assess if str1 can be converted into str2 through zero or more transformations. In a single transformation, all instances of a character in str1 can be changed to any other lowercase English letter. Return true if such a transformation is possible, otherwise false.
constraints: Strings have equal length and lowercase letters.
One operation replaces every occurrence of one character.
hints: Each source character must always map to the same destination character.
If strings already match, no operation is needed.
Otherwise a consistent mapping is possible only when the target leaves at least one of 26 letters unused.
A spare letter breaks mapping cycles; inconsistency or a full target alphabet is the only obstruction.
editorial: A spare letter breaks mapping cycles; inconsistency or a full target alphabet is the only obstruction.

tests.explanation: Mappings a→c,b→d,c→e are consistent and a spare letter breaks cycles.
One source character would need conflicting destinations.
